headlines.title: 中国央行：二季度末人民币房地产贷款余额50.74万亿元，同比下降4.9%
headlines.summary: 中国央行发布2026年二季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告。报告提到，2026年二季度末，人民币房地产贷款余额50.74万亿元，同比下降4.9%，上半年减少1.23万亿元。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: RMB real estate loans outstanding at 50.74 trillion yuan at end-Q2, down 4.9% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: PBOC released the 2026 Q2 report on financial institution loan trends. It noted that at end-Q2, outstanding RMB real estate loans stood at 50.74 trillion yuan, down 4.9% YoY, with a net decrease of 1.23 trillion yuan in H1.

headlines.title: 人民银行上海总部：上半年长三角地区人民币存款增加4.67万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行上海总部发布2026年上半年长三角地区货币信贷运行情况。6月末，长三角地区本外币各项存款余额91.89万亿元，同比增长8.3%。其中，人民币存款余额88.8万亿元，同比增长8.2%；外币存款余额4545亿美元，同比增长14.4%。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: RMB deposits in Yangtze River Delta region increased by 4.67 trillion yuan in H1
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC Shanghai Headquarters released H1 2026 monetary and credit operations for the Yangtze River Delta. At end-June, foreign and local currency deposits in the region totaled 91.89 trillion yuan, up 8.3% YoY. Among them, RMB deposits were 88.8 trillion yuan, up 8.2%; foreign currency deposits were $454.5 billion, up 14.4%.

headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际表示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产非本地买家中最大的群体，因香港写字楼板块低迷导致不良资产价格大幅回调，吸引了这些投资者。鉴于写字楼资产价格的走势，未来几个月新加坡的需求有望保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: End-Q2 loan availability rate for China's tech SMEs stands at 50.8%
headlines.summary_en: PBOC data released on July 28 shows that at end-Q2 2026, 305,600 tech-focused SMEs had loan support, with a loan approval rate of 50.8%, up 0.6 ppts from end-2025; outstanding loans to these SMEs in foreign and local currency reached 4.15 trillion yuan, up 20.1% YoY, 15 ppts faster than overall loan growth. The PBOC's report indicated that loan support for sci-tech enterprises remained stable this year. At end-Q2, 293,400 high-tech enterprises received loans, with a loan approval rate of 58.3%, up 1 ppt from end-2025; outstanding loans to high-tech firms in foreign and local currency stood at 21.53 trillion yuan, up 14.6% YoY, 9.5 ppts faster than overall loan growth. Meanwhile, green loans grew steadily.

headlines.title: 《财富》世界500强排行榜揭晓：亚马逊登顶，沃尔玛第二，中国国家电网第三
headlines.summary: 今年《财富》世界500强排行榜企业的营业收入总和约为43.1万亿美元，超过全球GDP的三分之一，比去年增长了约3.2%。此次上榜门槛（最低销售收入）从322亿美元增长至332亿美元，较一年前提高3%。所有上榜公司的净利润总和同比大幅增长约14%，约为3.4万亿美元。500家上榜公司的资产总额和净资产总额均达到自《财富》世界500强排行榜创立以来的最高峰，且雇佣员工总数相比去年有所增长。 亚马逊成为全球最大公司，终结了沃尔玛连续十二年的领跑纪录。沃尔玛位列第二。中国的国家电网有限公司继续位列第三。排在第四和第五位的分别是联合健康集团和沙特阿美公司。

headlines.title_en: Fortune Global 500 unveiled: Amazon tops, Walmart second, China's State Grid third
headlines.summary_en: This year's Fortune Global 500 companies had total revenue of approximately $43.1 trillion, exceeding one-third of global GDP, up about 3.2% from last year. The threshold for entry (minimum revenue) rose from $32.2 billion to $33.2 billion, up 3% from a year earlier. Net profits of all listed companies surged about 14% YoY to roughly $3.4 trillion. Total assets and net assets of the 500 companies both hit record highs since the list's inception, and total employment rose from last year. Amazon became the world's largest company, ending Walmart's 12-year streak. Walmart ranked second. China's State Grid Corporation remained third. UnitedHealth Group and Saudi Aramco ranked fourth and fifth, respectively.

headlines.title: 德国央行称伊朗冲突冲击下 德国经济料仍实现增长
headlines.summary: 德国央行表示，德国经济第二季度可能实现温和增长，这一增长势头预计将延续至第三季度。德国央行周二表示，4月至6月期间，德国经济产出可能“小幅增长”。这一判断较此前预计的经济停滞更为乐观，不过，7月至9月的经济增速预计将有所放缓。德国央行在月度报告中表示，“总体而言，当前一系列经济指标显示，德国经济的潜在增长率略高于我们在6月预测中的预期。”

headlines.title_en: German central bank says German economy still expected to grow despite Iran conflict impact
headlines.summary_en: The German central bank said the German economy likely achieved modest growth in Q2, with this momentum expected to continue into Q3. The Bundesbank stated Tuesday that economic output likely 'grew slightly' from April to June. This assessment is more optimistic than the previous forecast of stagnation, though growth in Q3 is expected to slow. In its monthly report, the Bundesbank said, 'Overall, the current set of economic indicators suggests that Germany's potential growth rate is slightly higher than we expected in our June forecast.'

headlines.title: 何立峰出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰28日在深圳出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞。 何立峰强调，亚太是全球森林资源最富集、生态系统类型最多样的地区之一，森林面积占全球一半以上。中国始终致力于维护全球生态安全，传播生态文化和绿色理念，为亚太地区乃至全球生态文明建设贡献了中国智慧、中国方案。在各方共同努力下，亚太地区成为扭转全球森林资源下降趋势的主要力量。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: He Lifeng attends and addresses opening ceremony of 2026 APEC Meeting of Ministers Responsible for Forestry
headlines.summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng, a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended and addressed the opening of the 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry in Shenzhen on the 28th. He Lifeng emphasized that Asia-Pacific is one of the world's most forest-rich and ecologically diverse regions, with forests covering over half the global total. China remains committed to maintaining global ecological security, spreading ecological culture and green concepts, contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to ecological progress in Asia-Pacific and the world. Through collective efforts, the Asia-Pacific region has become a main force reversing the global forest decline trend. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 香港特区政府与国家工信部签署《关于推进部港共建制造业创新中心的合作协议》
headlines.summary: 香港特区政府与国家工业和信息化部28日在特区政府总部签署《关于推进部港共建制造业创新中心的合作协议》。 香港特区政府创新科技及工业局局长孙东和国家工业和信息化部副部长熊继军分别代表香港特区政府与国家工业和信息化部签署合作协议。此项合作协议旨在切实推进双方于2024年9月签署的《关于发展新质生产力推进新型工业化的合作协议》，深化内地和香港产业合作，促进香港更好融入和服务国家发展大局，共同支持在香港建设制造业创新中心。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SAR government and MIIT sign cooperation agreement on advancing ministry-HK co-building of manufacturing innovation centers
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong SAR Government and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology signed an agreement on July 28 at the SAR Government Headquarters to advance the co-building of a manufacturing innovation center. Hong Kong SAR Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong and MIIT Vice Minister Xiong Jijun signed on behalf of their respective sides. The agreement aims to implement the September 2024 cooperation pact on developing new productive forces and promoting new industrialization, deepen mainland-HK industrial cooperation, facilitate HK's better integration into national development, and jointly support the construction of a manufacturing innovation center in Hong Kong.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai-listed companies' 2025 annual report dividends distributed exceed 1 trillion yuan; dividend low-volatility ETF sees nearly 23 billion yuan net inflow year-to-date
headlines.summary_en: As of July 28, Shanghai-listed companies had distributed over 1 trillion yuan in 2025 annual report cash dividends, with about 120 billion yuan remaining to be paid out soon. As of that date, 29 firms had cumulative actual dividends exceeding 10 billion yuan for 2025, including ICBC, China Mobile, and CCB with over 100 billion yuan, and six others like ABC, PetroChina, and Kweichow Moutai with over 50 billion yuan. Meanwhile, low-volatility high-dividend ETFs are becoming key for incremental fund allocation. From Jan 1 to July 27, Shanghai-listed ETFs distributed 20.8 billion yuan in dividends, accounting for 95% of the domestic total, with two CSI 300 ETFs distributing over 4.5 billion yuan. headlines.title_en: SSE agreement repo participant display list expands, adding 8 financial institutions
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Stock Exchange released an updated list of lenders for bond pledged reverse repo operations, marking its first centralized update of disclosed information. The latest list expands to 22 lenders, adding 8 financial institutions compared to the initial batch, with updated details on acceptable collateral scopes and business contacts for some listed entities.

headlines.title: 生态环境部：推动建立生态环境损害赔偿制度规范体系
headlines.summary: 生态环境部法规与标准司司长赵柯28日在例行新闻发布会上表示，为落实生态环境法典规定，进一步推动受损生态环境得到有效修复，将开展以下工作：一是进一步加强立法，推进部门规章的研究编制，推动形成以生态环境法典为统领、相关配套制度为支撑的生态环境损害赔偿制度规范体系。二是加强鉴定评估技术保障，推动生态环境损害智能评估（e评估）系统建设，扩大智能评估应用覆盖面。三是进一步提升生态环境损害修复实效，健全“损害赔偿－生态修复－效果评估”全链条闭环管理模式。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: Promoting establishment of a standardized system for ecological environment damage compensation
headlines.summary_en: Zhao Ke, Director of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment's Law and Standards Department, stated at a press conference on July 28 that to implement the Ecological Code and better restore damaged ecosystems, the following steps will be taken: First, strengthen legislation by advancing departmental rules and forming a compensation system with the code as the centerpiece. Second, enhance technical support for damage assessment by developing an intelligent evaluation (e-assessment) system and expanding its coverage. Third, improve restoration effectiveness with a full-chain closed-loop management of 'compensation, restoration, and evaluation.' (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 生态环境部：抓紧推进生态环境法典配套制度的制修订
headlines.summary: 生态环境部法规与标准司司长赵柯28日在例行新闻发布会上透露，生态环境部将积极担当、主动作为，按程序抓紧推进生态环境法典配套制度的制修订工作，做好与法典的衔接，确保各项制度规定能接得住、接得稳、接得顺，最大限度地保障好法典的落地。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: Accelerating formulation and revision of supporting systems for the Ecological Environment Code
headlines.summary_en: Zhao Ke, Director of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment's Law and Standards Department, disclosed at a press conference on July 28 that the ministry will actively take the lead in speeding up the revision of supporting rules for the Ecological Code in accordance with procedures, ensuring seamless integration with the code so that all regulations can be implemented smoothly and effectively, maximizing the code's implementation. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 商务部：中国不是欧盟面临经贸问题的根源 而是解决问题的伙伴
headlines.summary: 商务部政策研究室主任林卫龙28日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，中国不是欧盟面临经贸问题的根源，而是解决问题的伙伴。保护主义没有出路，合作共赢才是正道。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China is not the root of EU's economic and trade problems but a partner in solving them
headlines.summary_en: Lin Weilong, Director of the Ministry of Commerce's Policy Research Office, stated at a State Council press conference on July 28 that China is not the root of the EU's trade problems but a partner in solving them. Protectionism leads nowhere, while win-win cooperation is the right path. (Shanghai Securities News)
